# Mr. Hoff's Auto Detailing

> Full-service auto detail shop in Richmond, Virginia, specializing in ceramic coatings. Owner-operated by Dean Hoffman ("Mr. Hoff") at the same Waller Road location for nearly 40 years. Licensed and insured. Voted Best Car Detailer in a local reader poll. 5.0 on Google from 81 reviews.

## Contact
- Name: Mr. Hoff's Auto Detailing (also written "Mr. Hoffs Auto Detailing")
- Address: 4843 Waller Rd, Richmond, VA 23230
- Phone: (804) 355-4633
- Website: https://mr-hoffs-auto-detailing.netlify.app/
- Quote request form: https://mr-hoffs-auto-detailing.netlify.app/contact.html
- Owner: Dean Hoffman

## Hours
- Monday to Friday: 6:00 AM to 2:30 PM
- Saturday and Sunday: closed

## Services
- Full-service detailing (interior and exterior)
- Interior detailing
- Exterior detailing
- Ceramic coatings (shop specialty)
- Paint prep for ceramic coating (decontamination and polishing)
- Restoration detailing for classic and collector cars
- New-vehicle protection

## Prices
- Price level: $$
- No published price list. Every job is quoted individually by phone. The shop is known for keeping prices low.

## How to book
- Call (804) 355-4633 during weekday shop hours, or send a quote request at https://mr-hoffs-auto-detailing.netlify.app/contact.html.

## Reputation
- Voted #1 Best Car Detailer in a local magazine reader poll. The feature says owner Dean Hoffman "has kept prices low and relied on word-of-mouth referrals to his mom-and-pop shop specializing in ceramic coatings" and calls him "a whizz at full restoration projects."
- Dean Hoffman: "It's very, very personal service." and "And it's always on time. We never ever miss our deadline."
- Google rating: 5.0 from 81 reviews.

## FAQ
- How much does detailing or ceramic coating cost? Every vehicle is quoted individually; call (804) 355-4633.
- What are the hours? Monday to Friday, about 6:00 AM to 2:30 PM; closed weekends.
- Where is it? 4843 Waller Rd, Richmond, VA 23230, the same location for nearly 40 years.
- Do I need to call ahead? Yes, calling ahead is the best way to book and get a firm ready time.
- Do they work on classic cars? Yes. Dean is known for full restoration projects and also works on many new models.
- Are they licensed and insured? Yes.
